output.description: Aris Search sells to managed service providers (MSPs) across the United States that deliver outsourced IT support—helpdesk, cloud, network, security, and project engineering—to their own clients, typically ranging from small owner-run shops up to larger regional roll-ups (roughly 1 to 150 employees per site). The buyer is the person who owns the decision to engage an outside recruiter for technical hires or who owns the technical headcount those hires fill—owners, founders, service-delivery and operations leaders, or HR/talent-acquisition leads. These MSPs are found nationwide, with the seller noting particular strength in Chicago and Dallas markets.

seller.competitorTest: A competitor in this space typically sells generalist IT recruiting services to any technology company, regardless of whether that company itself delivers managed services to outside clients.

buyer.rubric: Owners, founders, CEOs, presidents, COOs, and VPs/directors of service delivery, operations, managed services, or professional services at MSPs own this recruiting decision, as do heads of HR, recruiting managers, and directors of talent acquisition who own the recruiter relationship; market/regional presidents at roll-ups also own regional hiring. CFOs, controllers, VP/directors of sales or marketing, CTOs/CIOs at larger MSPs, security-delivery roles like CISO/vCISO, board members, and PE-parent executives carry senior titles but do not buy this.

requirements.text: The company must operate as a managed service provider (MSP) delivering outsourced IT support to its own clients.
The company must have between 1 and 150 employees.
The company must not itself be an IT staffing or recruiting firm.
The company must be based in the United States.
There is a dated situation, signal, or trigger indicating the company is actively hiring or expanding its technical or service-delivery staff.
